007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.vectorindex;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.VectorIndex;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.VectorIndexAttributes;
014import org.slf4j.Logger;
015import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
016
017/**
018 * Sample for reading vector-index attributes from database metadata.
019 *
020 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, open an
021 * existing {@link VectorIndex} by name, call
022 * {@link VectorIndex#getVectorIndexAttributes()}, and print the loaded
023 * attributes.</p>
024 *
025 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
026 * <ul>
027 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
028 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
029 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
030 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME</li>
031 * </ul>
032 *
033 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
034 * <pre>{@code
035 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
036 * }</pre>
037 *
038 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
039 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
040 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
041 * <pre>{@code
042 * mvn clean install
043 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
044 * }</pre>
045 *
046 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
047 * <pre>{@code
048 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
049 *   -d samples/out \
050 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/vectorindex/GetVectorIndexAttributesSample.java
051 * }</pre>
052 *
053 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
054 * <pre>{@code
055 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
056 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.vectorindex.GetVectorIndexAttributesSample
057 * }</pre>
058 *
059 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
060 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
061 * and diagnostics.</p>
062 */
063public final class GetVectorIndexAttributesSample {
064    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(GetVectorIndexAttributesSample.class);
065
066    private GetVectorIndexAttributesSample() {
067    }
068
069    public static void main(String[] args) {
070        String indexName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME");
071
072        try {
073            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
074            VectorIndex vectorIndex = selectAI.vectorIndex(indexName);
075            VectorIndexAttributes attributes = vectorIndex.getVectorIndexAttributes();
076
077            System.out.printf("Vector index attributes for %s:%n", vectorIndex.getIndexName());
078            if (attributes == null) {
079                System.out.println("No vector index attributes found.");
080                return;
081            }
082            printAttributes(attributes);
083        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
084            LOGGER.error("Failed to read attributes for Select AI vector index '{}'.", indexName, e);
085        }
086    }
087
088    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
089        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
090                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
091                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
092                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
093                .build();
094
095        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
096    }
097
098    private static void printAttributes(VectorIndexAttributes attributes) {
099        System.out.printf("chunkSize: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(attributes.getChunkSize()));
100        System.out.printf("chunkOverlap: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(attributes.getChunkOverlap()));
101        System.out.printf("enableSources: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(attributes.getEnableSources()));
102        System.out.printf("location: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(attributes.getLocation()));
103        System.out.printf("matchLimit: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(attributes.getMatchLimit()));
104        System.out.printf("objectStorageCredentialName: %s%n",
105                valueOrEmpty(attributes.getObjectStorageCredentialName()));
106        System.out.printf("pipelineName: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(attributes.getPipelineName()));
107        System.out.printf("profileName: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(attributes.getProfileName()));
108        System.out.printf("refreshRate: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(attributes.getRefreshRate()));
109        System.out.printf("similarityThreshold: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(attributes.getSimilarityThreshold()));
110        System.out.printf("vectorDistanceMetric: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(attributes.getVectorDistanceMetric()));
111        System.out.printf("vectorDbProvider: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(attributes.getVectorDbProvider()));
112        System.out.printf("vectorDimension: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(attributes.getVectorDimension()));
113        System.out.printf("vectorTableName: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(attributes.getVectorTableName()));
114    }
115
116    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
117        String value = System.getenv(name);
118        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
119            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
120        }
121        return value;
122    }
123
124    private static String valueOrEmpty(Object value) {
125        return value == null ? "" : String.valueOf(value);
126    }
127}
